name: Hoshizora Miruki
source:
A cheerful girl who loves the stars.

[Spoiler]She suffers from a terminal illness and has escaped from the hospital to go on the trip. Her star-shaped necklace has only one day's worth of medicine for her condition.

Sickness:

Autassassinophilia: Sexual arousal derived from fear; the more she's scared, the more she gets turned on.

N-cell leukemia sealed her fate. She's destined to die, no matter what.[/spoiler]

[Based on the in-game profile]

[Spoiler]Despite escaping the island, she still dies from the illness.

Her real name is Izunase Himea (五津奈瀬 姫亞).[/spoiler]
